This post is from the site I kept at the Courant Institute (2008–2011). It's kept here as an archive; some links are dead and references are dated.

::: content
I just got back from the [Joint Math Meetings](http://www.ams.org/amsmtgs/2124_intro.html) and had a great time. I interviewed candidates, gave a few talks (one on [docutils](http://www.ams.org/amsmtgs/2124_intro.html), one on graduate student teaching development), watched a few talks, and met with new and old friends. I also did a lot of tweeting on the [#JointMath](http://search.twitter.com/search?q=%23jointmath) channel.

Now I'm excited about a new academic term. I'll be teaching two sections of [Calculus](/categories/calculus/){.alinks-link} I and one of Discrete Math.

I think mod_security2 is messing with me, so here's the link to the second talk: [pedagogical content knowledge in graduate student teaching fellows](http://www.ams.org/amsmtgs/2124_abstracts/1056-p5-680.pdf)
:::
